description: RDG by A9(a): the average of the boat's points in every other race, to the nearest tenth with 0.05 rounded up; the other boats keep their scores.
citation: RRS 2025-2028 A9(a): 'points equal to the average, to the nearest tenth of a point (0.05 to be rounded upward), of her points in all the races in the series except the race in question'. A6.2: 'If the protest committee decides to give redress by adjusting a boat's score, the scores of other boats shall not be changed unless the protest committee decides otherwise.' A10: 'RDG Redress given'.
working: R3 crossing order A B D C E. C is given redress, so her 4th place is not vacated (A6.2): A 1, B 2, D 3, E 5.
C's RDG by A9(a) averages her other four races: (2 + 3 + 1 + 3) / 4 = 9 / 4 = 2.25, which is exactly halfway, so 0.05 rounds upward: 2.3.
No two nets are equal: A, C, B, D, E.
Two wrong readings this vector catches: moving E up to 4th in R3 (E 23), and rounding the average down or not at all (C 11.2 or 11.25).
